reviews.comment: Schwartz is passionate about history and his lectures tend to be very good. My only complaint is that some of the classes were too discussion-based, which tended to be a bit unimportant for the exams and papers. There are only two exams, all of which are written and very manageable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved this class and Dr. Schwartz. He was very engaging, loved what he was teaching and was very understanding when I missed a week of work because I was sick.

The subject material was interesting but he taught the class like it was 20-40 people when it was almost 200. We had discussion days where only the same 3 people talked and weekly papers that you'd get a 100 on just by turning it in, no matter what you wrote. I appreciate what he was trying to do, but the class structure just wasn't it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: GO TO CLASS. The prof definitely wants his students to succeed, but you would not be able to tell from the PowerPoint. They are minimalistic at best. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you don't go you won't have a chance on the exams. There was no final, just a final group project that wasn't too bad. Easy A as long as you show up and take notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Schwartz is a true King. He has given the class so many opportunities to succeed. He is very forgiving and understanding when it comes to real life struggles that may hinder class performance. His lectures are very interesting despite the fact they were online for my semester. There is a hefty amount of reading, but its legit.

He's a great prof and gives amazing lectures. The midterm was hard but manageable and the term paper wasn't too long. There were also a couple of smaller papers throughout the semester, but they were for pass/fail credit. He expects a lot of reading before each class, but he won't directly ask you about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was a really nice guy that really cared about what he was teaching but to be honest, the class was a lot more work than I expected. I spent hours on the dumb readings every week but if I put in an effort, I got all the points. The lectures were a little hard to follow tbh but just type up as much as possible. you can get an A if you try though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Schwartz is so nice and a really great Professor! The class itself is a lot of work but if you go to lecture you really get a lot out of it. Theres only two tests, one group project and one short essay so there isnt a lot of room to mess up. The readings are short and as long as you turn in the homework you should be fine.

Reading responses due every week, lots of reading. The only tests were midterm and final. There's also a group project and an essay. If you read, pay attention to the lectures, and take notes, you can get an A. Not a lot of text on his powerpoints so you have to listen and take notes. Very nice guy and passionate about what he teaches.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor but graded hard! Only notes were ones you took and nothing was ever posted to ecampus. Only grades were the midterm, short essay, and final. The midterm/final were extremely hard and was not a blowoff class. Lectures are boring and had to be in class to turn in reading responses, no online submissions. Professor himself was nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I don't recommend taking this class for an easy A. An A is totally possible, but you will have to study and sit through lectures for it. He only had a midterm and final, which is going to make or break your grade. Just take good lecture notes and actually read the book and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: lectures are boring and its really easy to skip class BUT DONT if you do youre gonna have a hard time on any assignments that arent the reading guides, also a tough grader on the essays and project, definitely not a class to blow off because it can get really stressful really quick
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is a class you go to and you have to write your own notes off lecture. His reviews tell you nothing but having short essays on test. There are primary source readings you have to identify & write about, he gives you several at one time. There are writing responses every week. He doesn't curve & the only extra credit is doing 3 extra responses.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took his class as a blow off and the majority of it was. We had weekly discussions due that weren't hard at all. Everyone just kinda blew it off. We only had two other assignments besides the discussions that weren't hard. The reason I would not take him again is because of the midterm and final. They were unbelievably hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Such a great prof! I took his for my Culture elective, and he was great. Interesting lectures and reading responses graded on completion. One midterm, and if you liked your grade you didnt have to take the final! One easy paper also! Definitely take this class!

Great prof for church history. Reading responses each week are reasonable and connect to the lectures. You have to take your own notes and show up to lecture but as long as you pay attention you'll be fine. Easy midterm and he made the final optional if you liked your grade. He's not interested in testing you over minutae

Dr. Schwartz is the best. I loved his class! He relies heavily on the primary sources, but as long as you do all of the reading responses and pay attention, you'll do extremely well! He really wants his students to do well.

Professor Schwartz is an excellent lecturer. He is very passionate about his subject and sometimes goes off on tangents about related topics. He only uses powerpoints to show pictures and essential vocab, not as a guide for the lecture. Some of the readings for the class can be difficult, but the responses are only worth 4 points.
